# Controlled editor compatibility fixture

Browser-only test assets from official npm releases: draft-js 0.11.7, react and react-dom 16.14.0, immutable 3.8.2. Distributed under the accompanying MIT licenses. These frozen UMD assets exercise real Draft.js controlled EditorState; they are never included in the extension package or used in production. The fixture models a compact editor with a 27.36px text region inside a 51.36px .editor shell; this does not assert any deployed site's library version.
